data.explanation: This is a notice from your gas supplier that your monthly costs will go up because of higher energy-market charges. Your fixed monthly advance payment will increase from €96.00 to €109.00 starting from the date shown in the letter. Because prices are being raised, German law gives you the right to cancel this contract early, in text form (e.g. by email), without waiting for the usual notice period — the cancellation would take effect on the date the new prices start. If you do nothing, the new prices simply apply automatically. If you think the increase is unjustified or want a cheaper tariff, compare offers and consider using this special cancellation right before it expires.
